_comment: Allowlists for LOKI's system/dev tools. LOKI can only run what is listed here; commands always ask for approval. Paths are relative to the LOKI folder. Edit freely and restart the backend.

git_status.description: Show uncommitted changes in the LOKI repository

git_log.description: Show the last 10 commits of the LOKI repository

file_explorer.description: File Explorer at the LOKI folder

vscode.description: Visual Studio Code at the LOKI folder

daily_overview.description: Today's open tasks, upcoming reminders and calendar for the next 24 hours

start_coding.description: Open VS Code on LOKI and show the repository status
